summary: Everest Consolidator Acquisition Corp, a Delaware blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval on October 8, 2026, of amendments extending its deadline to complete an initial business combination to December 31, 2027. The trust agreement with Equiniti Trust Company was amended October 14, 2026, and the charter amendment was filed with Delaware the same day. Roughly 4.88 million shares were entitled to vote, including 563,504 Class A and 4,312,500 Class B shares. No deal, price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for redemptions, trust depletion, and any announced target before the extended termination date.
